( Done )Venue app - customize price. Reduce the number of clicks as much as possible. When users click customize price, they want to customize price. So reduce the steps to the keyboard for them to enter the numbers.  For example, when clicking into the input box, automatically delete the numbers so it is ready for users to enter new price.   Even better: when users tap “Customize price”, the keyboard shows up for them directly enter number is even better.   If the entire screen is a big number pad (no need to show the product info again - a title might be necessary) for them to customize the price, it is even better.  The current UI :  everything is too small for on-site use.  @Le Gong   @Zheng Zhu   @Dian Yuhong

(Will resolve in KAT-12327)   (Grace) Waitlist - Invoice link - Configure Waitlist settings in advance  @cici Huang Currently, under  Event → Attendees , the  Waitlist  only becomes accessible and appears under Attendees after a pre-approval request has been submitted. However, for cases involving invoice link requests, we need to configure the approval and decline email templates and set the expiration time before any approval requests come in. This ensures everything is set up correctly before we send invoice links to customers.  Problem to solve:  The current method of triggering the Waitlist by submitting a pre-approval request may be confusing and difficult for partners to understand. We need a way to access and configure the Waitlist—including email templates and expiration settings—without requiring a pre-approval request to be submitted first.
